verdict.rationale: Ramp offers relevant automations—auto-receipt capture with AI categorization, invoice-to-GL coding and approval, and real-time bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries—which directly speed up close processes, plus customer proof points on faster onboarding/tool consolidation. However, all evidence is vendor-claimed docs with no independent verification of month-end close time reduction specifically, so it's a plausible but unconfirmed fit.
